_comment: The authoritative, machine-readable research specification (see docs/RESEARCH-CONTRACT.md for the human-readable companion). This file documents thresholds that already exist and are enforced elsewhere in the pipeline -- it is a consolidation layer, not a new parallel set of numbers. Where a value differs from what's actually enforced today, 'enforced_in' says exactly where, and 'implementation_status' says whether the contract and the code agree yet.

universe._comment: Configured symbol list lives in advisor_universe.json (910 symbols, 21 portfolio holdings, publish_limit 40). ETF/stock classification lives in universe.json.
universe.supported_exchanges: whatever Yahoo/Alpha Vantage resolve for the configured symbol list; no explicit exchange allowlist exists yet

security_types.etf: scored by a separate model (fetch_etfs.py); ineligible for stock sleeves, reason code unsupported_security_type -- see src/lib/researchScreens.js stocksOnly()
security_types.adr: not distinguished from common stock today; no separate handling implemented
security_types.reit: distinguished via business_profiles.json peer-group classification (peer_groups.py), not via a universe-eligibility rule

minimum_median_dollar_volume_60d.note: Distinct from the two liquidity modifier thresholds below -- this one gates screen eligibility, those adjust score.

liquidity_score_modifier.note: This is a score modifier (points penalty), not a hard eligibility gate -- kept distinct from minimum_median_dollar_volume_60d above, which excludes a name from the momentum screen outright.

pairwise_correlation_minimum_observation.enforced_in: portfolioAnalytics.js correlationDiversification (frontend, not yet mirrored in pipeline)

universe.ipo_seasoning: no explicit newly-listed exclusion window implemented; a recent IPO is only implicitly filtered by minimum_history_sessions
universe.delisted_securities: not retained in historical analysis today; the raw PIT store (pipeline/pit_store.py) preserves a universe membership log (universe.jsonl: added/removed per observation) but scoring does not yet replay a delisted name's history
universe.corporate_actions: handled at the price/fundamentals-provider layer (Yahoo-adjusted series); no independent corporate-action event log exists yet
universe.missing_fundamentals: a company with zero enrichment still competes on core (non-statement) metrics; see pipeline/confidence.py completeness_component for how that shows up in confidence

forecast_targets._comment: The preregistered primary target is a 63-trading-session forward sector-residual total return. pipeline/validation/ic_harness.py evaluates it prospectively from immutable snapshots; calendar-day raw returns remain secondary diagnostics.

primary.definition: forward_residual_return(i, t, h) = stock_total_return(i, t -> t+h) - sector_or_risk_adjusted_return(i, t -> t+h)
primary.note: The calculation is implemented; statistical eligibility remains gated until 24 closed monthly periods exist.

currently_implemented_horizons._comment: Session-based sector-residual targets are primary_variants; calendar-day raw-return horizons are retained as explicitly labeled secondary diagnostics.

forecast_targets.total_return_basis: Yahoo-adjusted close series (splits/dividends folded into price); no separate distribution-reinvestment tracking
forecast_targets.forward_label_timing: ic_harness.py's append_refresh only appends realized labels once the full horizon has elapsed relative to data_as_of -- see minimum_icir_periods gating in settings.json validation

execution_assumptions.signal_timestamp: advisor.json generated_at (the refresh's own generation time)
execution_assumptions.earliest_tradable_timestamp: not modeled -- no same-close-execution guard exists yet; a signal generated intraday could theoretically be tested against that same session's close
execution_assumptions.rebalance_frequency: no fixed cadence; refresh-advisor.yml runs a full sweep once and 2 fast refreshes on trading days (07:00, 12:00, 15:00 ET)
execution_assumptions.execution_price: not modeled in the live pipeline; shadow_portfolios.py and backtest_monthly.py use their own next-session-open or close assumptions -- see those modules directly, not centralized here yet
execution_assumptions.earnings_event_handling: surfaced as a flag (technical_detail/insider_signal event proximity) but not excluded from execution by rule
execution_assumptions.corporate_action_handling: relies on provider-adjusted prices; no independent handling

current.note: flat cost, not the half_spread + fees + volatility_scaled_impact model this contract calls for

execution_assumptions.holding_period: not fixed; determined by whatever horizon a given challenger/backtest module tests
execution_assumptions.portfolio_weighting: not centralized; src/lib/portfolioAnalytics.js and pipeline/optimize_weights.py each make their own assumptions

champion.description: Sector/industry-band fundamental scoring blended with technical and news components. See advisor_engine.blend_research_components.

champion_challenger_governance.promotion_gates: docs/RESEARCH-CONTRACT.md section 12 (mirrors the upgrade plan's promotion-gate list); none have been evaluated because the IC harness has not yet reached minimum_icir_periods -- see pipeline/validation/ic_harness.py
